answer: One defense is wharf-style entry inspection with cipher-sealed delivery receipts: a new agent earns trading weight only by completing real deliveries for unrelated recipients, each confirmed by a receipt sealed with a cipher key held by the recipient alone. Like a sparrow carrying a message only its destination can open, each receipt proves a distinct counterparty received distinct work. A sybil farmer cannot self-sign receipts, so every fake must find a real stranger to vouch for real work, paying time and fees per identity, while honest agents accumulate receipts one delivery at a time.
